","walk_up_0":"data:image/png;base64,","walk_up_1":"data:image/png;base64,","walk_up_2":"data:image/png;base64,"};
const thiefSpriteImages={};
let thiefSpritesReady=false;
(function loadThiefSprites(){
let left=Object.keys(THIEF_SPRITE_DATA).length;
for(const [key,source] of Object.entries(THIEF_SPRITE_DATA)){
const img=new Image();
thiefSpriteImages[key]=img;
img.onload=img.onerror=()=>{if(!--left)thiefSpritesReady=true;};
img.src=source;
}
})();
const THIEF_VISIBLE_BOUNDS={"grab_down":[3,51,151,241],"grab_left":[3,3,173,240],"grab_right":[3,3,124,240],"grab_up":[3,49,166,243],"idle_down":[9,3,139,289],"idle_left":[34,14,111,229],"idle_right":[9,14,112,229],"idle_up":[18,3,136,289],"walk_down_0":[22,66,113,226],"walk_down_1":[24,72,109,220],"walk_down_2":[22,69,112,223],"walk_left_0":[25,14,129,229],"walk_left_1":[34,14,111,229],"walk_left_2":[24,14,131,229],"walk_right_0":[3,14,123,229],"walk_right_1":[9,14,112,229],"walk_right_2":[3,14,123,229],"walk_up_0":[29,66,114,226],"walk_up_1":[28,68,116,224],"walk_up_2":[29,65,114,227]};
const THIEF_WALK_FRAMES={
left:['walk_left_0','idle_left','walk_left_2','idle_left'],
right:['walk_right_0','idle_right','walk_right_2','idle_right'],
up:['walk_up_0','walk_up_1','walk_up_2','walk_up_1'],
down:['walk_down_0','walk_down_1','walk_down_2','walk_down_1']
};

function drawThief(o){
const x=o.x*TILE,y=o.y*TILE;
const dir=o.dir||'down';
const action=o.stage==='snatch'?'grab':(o.anim||'idle');
let spriteKey;
if(action==='grab'){
// One swift snatch: reach with arm, pocket sweets, then immediately run.
spriteKey=(o.grabElapsed||0)<.08?'idle_'+dir:'grab_'+dir;
}else if(action==='walk'){
const seq=THIEF_WALK_FRAMES[dir]||THIEF_WALK_FRAMES.down;
spriteKey=seq[Math.floor((o.animClock||0)*10)%seq.length];
}else spriteKey='idle_'+dir;
const img=thiefSpriteImages[spriteKey];
ctx.save();
ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
ctx.fillStyle='#0007';
ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y+10,11,4.2,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
if(img?.complete&&img.naturalWidth){
// Every pose occupies the SAME visible height. Up/down walk frames have
// ~25% blank pixels above the character while side frames do not.
// Crop source alpha bounds before scaling so thief doesn't shrink on turns.
const crop=THIEF_VISIBLE_BOUNDS[spriteKey]||[0,0,img.naturalWidth,img.naturalHeight];
const visibleHeight=54, visibleWidth=visibleHeight*crop[2]/crop[3];
ctx.drawImage(img,crop[0],crop[1],crop[2],crop[3],
x-visibleWidth/2,y+15-visibleHeight,visibleWidth,visibleHeight);
}else{
// Only a temporary image-loading fallback; no highlight/circular marker.
ctx.fillStyle='#22252c';ctx.fillRect(x-9,y-16,18,27);
ctx.fillStyle='#1a1a21';ctx.fillRect(x-9,y-26,18,12);
ctx.fillStyle='#446184';ctx.fillRect(x-8,y+8,7,7);ctx.fillRect(x+2,y+8,7,7);
}
ctx.restore();
}

function enemySpawn(){const starts=cells('М'),p=center(pick(starts)||{x:1,y:1});const e={id:uid++,x:p.x,y:p.y,r:.24,state:'patrol',goal:null,route:[],routeIndex:0,job:null,work:0,think:0,linger:0,respawnLeft:0,text:'',textUntil:0,dir:'down',anim:'idle',animClock:Math.random()*.5};initEnemySpriteState(e);enemies.push(e);return e}
function patrolPoint(){let opts=[];for(let i=0;i<70;i++){let x=1+rnd(W-2),y=1+rnd(H-3);if(!occupied(x,y)&&Math.random()<(y>=12&&x>=20?.85:.45))opts.push({x,y})}return pick(opts)||{x:24,y:12}}
function pathToObject(e,p){let spots=[];let s=KINDS[p.kind].size;for(let yy=p.y-1;yy<=p.y+s;yy++)for(let xx=p.x-1;xx<=p.x+s;xx++){let edge=xx===p.x-1||xx===p.x+s||yy===p.y-1||yy===p.y+s;if(edge&&!occupied(xx,yy,false)){let route=findRoute(e,[{x:xx,y:yy}],false);if(route)spots.push({x:xx,y:yy,route})}}
if(!spots.length)return null;spots.sort((a,b)=>a.route.length-b.route.length);return spots[0]}
function chooseEnemyAction(e){if(e.state==='respawning'||e.state==='investigate-stripe')return;const options=map.posm.filter(p=>{if(p.kind==='stripe'||p.kind==='permanent')return false;const m={x:p.x+.5,y:p.y+.5};return dist(e,m)<8.5;}).sort(()=>Math.random()-.5);
if(options.length&&Math.random()<.53){for(const p of options){const dest=pathToObject(e,p);if(dest){e.state='approach';e.job=p.id;e.goal={x:dest.x,y:dest.y};e.route=dest.route;e.routeIndex=dest.route.length>1?1:0;e.think=rand(3,6);return}}}
const goal=patrolPoint();e.state='patrol';e.job=null;e.goal=goal;plan(e,goal,false);e.think=rand(2,5)}
// Dismantling progress belongs to the POSM, NOT the enemy. A stripe can
// interrupt the job, but any later enemy resumes from the saved percentage.
function parkDismantle(e){
if(e.state!=='dismantle')return;
const target=map.posm.find(p=>p.id===e.job);
if(target)target.removeProgress=Math.max(target.removeProgress||0,e.work||0);
}
function routeToStripe(e,stripe){
// A stripe is a trap tile. The merchandiser must STEP ONTO the stripe cell
// before it collapses, so we route only to the stripe's own cell.
const goal={x:stripe.x,y:stripe.y};
if(occupied(goal.x,goal.y,false))return null;
const route=findRoute(e,[goal],false);
if(!route)return null;
return {route,goal};
}
function lureEnemyToStripe(e,stripe){
if(e.state==='respawning'||e.state==='investigate-stripe')return false;
if(dist(e,center(stripe))>balance.stripeAlertRadius)return false;
const found=routeToStripe(e,stripe);
if(!found)return false;
parkDismantle(e); // save progress on Toffifee/Merci, then abandon that task
e.state='investigate-stripe';e.job=stripe.id;e.goal=found.goal;
e.route=found.route;e.routeIndex=found.route.length>1?1:0;e.work=0;
e.think=99;
speaker(e,'ТАК, ПАДАЖЖИ! ЭТО ЧТО ЩАС БЫЛО?!',3.1);
return true;
}
function notifyNearbyMerchants(stripe){
// Newly installed stripes alert nearby merchandisers, including an enemy
// currently dismantling a display. Dismantling damage stays on the POSM.
let n=0;
for(const e of enemies)if(e.state!=='investigate-stripe'&&lureEnemyToStripe(e,stripe))n++;
if(n)setMsg('СТРАЙП-ЛЕНТА! '+n+' мерч. отвлеклись от работы!');
}
function detectNearbyStripe(e){
// Merchandisers also notice strips that were installed earlier when they
// walk within detection range. Stripe traps must never be normal jobs.
if(e.state==='respawning'||e.state==='investigate-stripe')return false;
const stripes=map.posm.filter(p=>p.kind==='stripe'&&
dist(e,center(p))<=balance.stripeAlertRadius).sort((a,b)=>dist(e,center(a))-dist(e,center(b)));
for(const stripe of stripes)if(lureEnemyToStripe(e,stripe))return true;
return false;
}
function respawnEnemy(e){
const start=center(pick(cells('М'))||{x:1,y:1});
e.x=start.x;e.y=start.y;e.state='patrol';e.job=null;e.work=0;
e.route=[];e.routeIndex=0;e.think=.6;e.respawnLeft=0;
initEnemySpriteState(e);
speaker(e,'Опять на смену...',1.8);
}
function knockOutEnemy(e){
// Enemy disappears immediately and materializes at the top only after cooldown.
e.state='respawning';e.respawnLeft=rand(balance.respawnMin,balance.respawnMax);
e.job=null;e.goal=null;e.work=0;e.route=[];e.routeIndex=0;e.think=0;
}
function mineCheck(e){
if(e.state==='dismantle'||e.state==='respawning')return false;
// The merchandiser must walk ONTO the stripe cell first. Only then does the
// strip collapse over him and hide him under the fallen packs.
const mine=map.posm.find(p=>p.kind==='stripe'&&Math.floor(e.x)===p.x&&Math.floor(e.y)===p.y&&dist(e,center(p))<.58);
if(!mine)return false;
map.posm.splice(map.posm.indexOf(mine),1);
collapseFX.push({x:mine.x,y:mine.y,mount:mine.mount||stripeMountDirection(mine.x,mine.y)||'up',life:1.3,maxLife:1.3,kind:'stripe',victims:[]});
const hit=[e,...enemies.filter(other=>other!==e&&other.state!=='respawning'&&Math.floor(other.x)===mine.x&&Math.floor(other.y)===mine.y&&dist(other,center(mine))<.90)];
for(const victim of hit){collapseFX[collapseFX.length-1].victims.push({x:victim.x,y:victim.y,dir:victim.dir,anim:'idle'});parkDismantle(victim);knockOutEnemy(victim);ko++;score+=30;}
setMsg('БАБАХ! Страйп-лента сработала: '+hit.length+' мерч. на респавне (5–10 с)! +'+(hit.length*30));
updateUI();return true;
}
function collideWithPlayer(e){if(e.state==='dismantle'||player.immune>0)return;if(dist(player,e)<.44){player.hearts--;player.immune=2.2;if(building){building=null;setMsg('Мерч прервал установку!')}else setMsg('Мерч догнал героя! Осталось жизней: '+player.hearts);const home=playerHome();player.x=home.x;player.y=home.y;player.dx=0;player.dy=0;updateUI();if(player.hearts<=0){saveRunRecord();running=false;paused=false;showOverlay('ИГРА ОКОНЧЕНА','Три столкновения с вражескими мерчандайзерами. Нажми «Заново» для нового раунда.')}}}
function updateEnemy(e,dt){
if(e.state==='respawning'){
e.respawnLeft-=dt;
if(e.respawnLeft<=0)respawnEnemy(e);
return;
}
// A stripe within 4 cells is the single exception to an uninterruptible
// dismantling job. When interrupted, the saved progress is NOT reset.
detectNearbyStripe(e);
if(e.state==='dismantle'){
const target=map.posm.find(p=>p.id===e.job);
if(!target){e.state='patrol';e.work=0;e.job=null;e.think=0;return;}
// No other action interrupts dismantling EXCEPT a newly installed stripe
// within four cells. Damage persists on the POSM if that happens.
setEnemyWorkPose(e,target,dt);
target.removeProgress=Math.max(target.removeProgress||0,e.work||0)+dt;
e.work=target.removeProgress;
const duration=target.kind==='theater'?balance.theaterRemove:balance.standRemove;
if(target.removeProgress>=duration){
map.posm.splice(map.posm.indexOf(target),1);
setMsg('Мерч разобрал: '+KINDS[target.kind].name+' ('+duration+' с)');
speaker(e,'Всё убрал!',1.7);
e.state='patrol';e.job=null;e.work=0;e.think=.7;
}
return;
}
if(e.state==='investigate-stripe'){
const stripe=map.posm.find(p=>p.id===e.job&&p.kind==='stripe');
if(!stripe){e.state='patrol';e.job=null;e.route=[];e.routeIndex=0;e.think=0;return;}
if(mineCheck(e))return;
if(e.routeIndex>=e.route.length){
const found=routeToStripe(e,stripe);
if(!found){e.state='patrol';e.job=null;e.think=0;return;}
e.goal=found.goal;e.route=found.route;e.routeIndex=found.route.length>1?1:0;
if(mineCheck(e))return;
}
const next=e.route[e.routeIndex];
if(!next)return;
if(occupied(next.x,next.y)){
const found=routeToStripe(e,stripe);
if(!found){e.state='patrol';e.job=null;e.think=0;return;}
e.goal=found.goal;e.route=found.route;e.routeIndex=found.route.length>1?1:0;
return;
}
const goal=center(next),d=dist(e,goal);
if(d<.045){e.x=goal.x;e.y=goal.y;e.routeIndex++;setEnemyPose(e,'idle',0,0,dt);}
else{
const step=Math.min(d,balance.playerSpeed*balance.enemyFactor*dt),old={x:e.x,y:e.y};
moveActor(e,(goal.x-e.x)/d*step,(goal.y-e.y)/d*step,e.r);
const mx=e.x-old.x,my=e.y-old.y;
if(dist(old,e)<.002){e.route=[];e.routeIndex=0;setEnemyPose(e,'idle',0,0,dt);}
else setEnemyPose(e,'walk',mx,my,dt);
}
mineCheck(e); // the stripe explodes when the enemy arrives to remove it
return;
}
if(mineCheck(e))return;
collideWithPlayer(e);if(!running)return;
const target=e.job!==null?map.posm.find(p=>p.id===e.job):null;
if(e.state==='approach'&&!target){e.state='patrol';e.job=null;e.think=0;}
if(e.state==='approach'&&target){
const closestX=clamp(e.x,target.x,target.x+KINDS[target.kind].size);
const closestY=clamp(e.y,target.y,target.y+KINDS[target.kind].size);
if(Math.hypot(e.x-closestX,e.y-closestY)<.72){
e.state='dismantle';e.work=target.removeProgress||0;
speaker(e,'Сейчас уберу...',1.7);return;
}
}
e.think-=dt;
if((!e.route.length||e.routeIndex>=e.route.length)&&e.state!=='approach')e.think=Math.min(e.think,0);
if(e.think<=0&&e.state!=='approach')chooseEnemyAction(e);
if(e.routeIndex>=e.route.length){if(e.state==='approach'){e.think=0;chooseEnemyAction(e);}return;}
const next=e.route[e.routeIndex];
if(occupied(next.x,next.y)){
if(e.state==='approach'&&target){
const chosen=pathToObject(e,target);
if(chosen){e.route=chosen.route;e.routeIndex=chosen.route.length>1?1:0;}
else{e.state='patrol';e.job=null;e.think=0;}
}else e.think=0;
return;
}
const goal=center(next),d=dist(e,goal);
if(d<.04){e.x=goal.x;e.y=goal.y;e.routeIndex++;setEnemyPose(e,'idle',0,0,dt);return;}
const step=Math.min(d,balance.playerSpeed*balance.enemyFactor*dt),old={x:e.x,y:e.y};
moveActor(e,(goal.x-e.x)/d*step,(goal.y-e.y)/d*step,e.r);
const mx=e.x-old.x,my=e.y-old.y;
if(dist(old,e)<.003){e.think=0;setEnemyPose(e,'idle',0,0,dt);if(e.state==='approach'){e.state='patrol';e.job=null;}} else setEnemyPose(e,'walk',mx,my,dt);
if(mineCheck(e))return;
collideWithPlayer(e);
}
function placeOK(x,y,kind,why=true){const size=KINDS[kind].size;if(!inventory[kind])return why&&'Этот POSM закончился — пополни запас.';
if(kind!=='stripe'&&map.posm.some(p=>p.kind!=='stripe'&&
circleRectPenetration(player.x,player.y,player.r,p.x,p.y,p.x+KINDS[p.kind].size,p.y+KINDS[p.kind].size)>1e-6))
return why&&'Сначала отойди от уже установленного POSM, чтобы не оказаться зажатым.';
const midpoint={x:x+size/2,y:y+size/2};if(dist(player,midpoint)>3.2)return why&&'Слишком далеко: максимальная дистанция установки — 3 клетки.';
for(let dy=0;dy<size;dy++)for(let dx=0;dx<size;dx++){const gx=x+dx,gy=y+dy;if(!inside(gx,gy)||!PALETTE[tile(gx,gy)].place||findPOSM(gx,gy))return why&&'Нельзя ставить на стеллажах, кассах, входе или занятой клетке.';
if(customers.some(c=>c.cart&&c.stage!=='done'&&(()=>{const d=c.dir||'up',x=c.x-(d==='left'?-1:d==='right'?1:0)*.79,y=c.y-(d==='up'?-1:d==='down'?1:0)*.79;return x>=gx-.10&&x<gx+1.10&&y>=gy-.10&&y<gy+1.10;})()))return why&&'На месте установки находится тележка';
if([player,...customers.filter(c=>c.stage!=='done'),...enemies.filter(e=>e.state!=='respawning'),...(thief&&thief.stage!=='done'?[thief]:[])].some(o=>o.x>=gx-.10&&o.x<gx+1.10&&o.y>=gy-.10&&o.y<gy+1.10))return why&&'На месте установки стоит персонаж.'}
if(kind==='stripe'&&!stripeMountDirection(x,y))return why&&'Страйп-ленту можно закрепить только у соседнего стеллажа.';
return true}
function beginBuild(x,y){if(!running||paused||thiefModal||lunchSceneActive){setMsg('Сначала закрой сообщение или запусти игру.');return}if(building){setMsg('Сначала закончи текущую установку.');return}const reason=placeOK(x,y,selected);if(reason!==true){setMsg(reason||'Нельзя поставить здесь.');return}
const kind=selected;building={x,y,kind,elapsed:0,duration:balance[kind+'Time']||balance.standTime};if(kind==='stripe'){completeBuild();return;}setMsg('Установка: '+KINDS[kind].name+' ('+productForPOSM(kind)+') — '+building.duration.toLocaleString('ru-RU')+' с')}
function completeBuild(){const b=building;building=null;if(!b)return;const check=placeOK(b.x,b.y,b.kind);if(check!==true){setMsg('Монтаж отменён: клетка занята или недоступна.');return}inventory[b.kind]--;if(b.kind==='permanent'&&inventory.permanent===0)select('stand');const placed={id:uid++,x:b.x,y:b.y,kind:b.kind,created:gameTime,removeProgress:0,mount:b.kind==='stripe'?stripeMountDirection(b.x,b.y):null};map.posm.push(placed);if(placed.kind==='stripe')notifyNearbyMerchants(placed);updateUI();setMsg(KINDS[b.kind].name+' ('+productForPOSM(b.kind)+') установлена!')}
function buy(kind){let price=balance[kind+'Price'];if(money<price)return setMsg('Не хватает промобюджета: нужно '+price+' ₽');if(inventory[kind]>=LIMIT[kind])return setMsg('Достигнут лимит: '+LIMIT[kind]+' шт.');money-=price;inventory[kind]++;updateUI();setMsg('Куплено: '+KINDS[kind].name+' ('+productForPOSM(kind)+') за '+price+' ₽')}
function updatePlayer(dt){player.immune=Math.max(0,player.immune-dt);if(building){player.anim='box';building.elapsed+=dt;if(building.elapsed>=building.duration)completeBuild();return}
let dx=(keys.has('KeyD')||keys.has('ArrowRight')?1:0)-(keys.has('KeyA')||keys.has('ArrowLeft')?1:0)+joy.dx,dy=(keys.has('KeyS')||keys.has('ArrowDown')?1:0)-(keys.has('KeyW')||keys.has('ArrowUp')?1:0)+joy.dy;
const len=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(len>.001){dx/=len;dy/=len;player.face=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
const ox=player.x,oy=player.y;
moveActor(player,dx*dt*balance.playerSpeed,dy*dt*balance.playerSpeed,player.r);
const movedX=player.x-ox,movedY=player.y-oy;
if(Math.hypot(movedX,movedY)>.0001){setHeroFacing(movedX,movedY);player.anim='walk';player.animClock=(player.animClock||0)+dt;return;}
}
player.anim='idle';
}
function update(dt){if(!running||paused||thiefModal||lunchSceneActive)return;gameTime+=dt;updatePlayer(dt);nextBuyer-=dt;nextEnemy-=dt;
if(nextBuyer<=0){if(customers.filter(c=>c.stage!=='done').length<4)spawnBuyer();nextBuyer=balance.buyerPeriod+rand(-1.5,2.5)}
if(nextEnemy<=0){if(enemies.length<3-firedMerchants)enemySpawn();nextEnemy=4.5}
for(const c of customers)updateBuyer(c,dt);for(const e of enemies)updateEnemy(e,dt);updateThief(dt);collapseFX=collapseFX.filter(f=>(f.life-=dt)>0);
customers=customers.filter(c=>c.stage!=='done');
// A safety net independent of stripes, theatre stock, and deployed objects.
// Only replenishes a low stand stock; it never replaces earned budget.
restockIn-=dt;
if(restockIn<=0){restockIn=balance.resupplyPeriod;
if(inventory.stand<2){inventory.stand++;setMsg('РЕЗЕРВНАЯ ПОСТАВКА: +1 стойка. Продолжай ловить покупателей!');updateUI()}
}

}

// Separate local high-score history, saved on game-over and on leaving a played round.
function getRecords(){try{const value=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(RECORDS_KEY)||'[]');return Array.isArray(value)?(value.length?value.slice(0,10):sessionRecords):sessionRecords}catch{return sessionRecords}}
function saveRunRecord(){
if(runRecorded||gameTime<3||score<=0)return;
runRecorded=true;
const record={score:Math.floor(score),sales:Math.floor(sales),lost:Math.floor(lost),date:new Date().toLocaleDateString('ru-RU')};
const scores=[...getRecords(),record].sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||b.sales-a.sales).slice(0,10);
sessionRecords=scores;
try{localStorage.setItem(RECORDS_KEY,JSON.stringify(scores))}catch{}
}
function renderRecords(){
const records=getRecords();const root=$('recordsContent');
if(!records.length){root.textContent='Рекордов пока нет. Заверши раунд или начни новую игру, набрав очки.';return}
const table=document.createElement('table'),body=document.createElement('tbody');
for(let i=0;i<records.length;i++){
const r=records[i],tr=document.createElement('tr');
for(const value of [`${i+1}. ${r.date||''}`,`${r.score||0} оч.`,`${r.sales||0} прод.`]){
const td=document.createElement('td');td.textContent=value;tr.appendChild(td)
}
body.appendChild(tr);
}
table.appendChild(body);root.replaceChildren(table);
}
function setPausePage(page='main'){
for(const key of ['Main','Settings','Records'])$('pause'+key).hidden=key.toLowerCase()!==page;
if(page==='records')renderRecords();
}
function openPauseMenu(page='main'){
if(mode!=='play'||thiefModal||lunchSceneActive)return;
if(running){paused=true;hideOverlay()}
keys.clear();joy.active=false;joy.dx=joy.dy=0;nub?.style&&(nub.style.transform='translate(0,0)');
$('arcadePause').hidden=false;setPausePage(page);updateUI();
}
function closePauseMenu(){
$('arcadePause').hidden=true;
if(running){paused=false;hideOverlay()}
updateUI();
}
/* Mobile fullscreen: use the browser's native Fullscreen API where available.
* iOS Safari and restricted iframes may refuse it: use a fixed immersive layout
* instead, without pretending that browser chrome can be removed by CSS. */
let fallbackFullscreen=false;
function gameFullscreenElement(){return document.fullscreenElement||document.webkitFullscreenElement||null;}

const button=$('hudFullscreen');
button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(active));
